step-run:
You are running step 2 of the plan fleet-demo from the evo-agents hub.

Rules for this run:
- Do this one step and nothing else. The other steps of the plan get runs of their own.
- Do not record progress in the plan: do not call the hub's plan_step tool, `evo harness step` or `evo-agents hub plan`. The hub writes this step's status and evidence from what this run reports.
- Work in the current directory and commit there, on the branch it is on (feat/fleet-demo). Do not switch branches, merge or push: the worker pushes the branch when the run ends.
- Before you finish, write .evo-run/result.json as a JSON object with two keys, and keep .evo-run/ out of your commits:
  "verify_commands": the shell commands you ran to check this step, each one a string;
  "summary": what you changed, how you checked it, and anything left undone.
  The worker runs every verify command again in this directory, and the step counts as verified only when each one exits 0.
- To show the people who read this run a file you made (a screenshot, a video, a report), send it with `evo-agents worker output FILE --caption TEXT` (several files at once if you like), or leave it in .evo-run/outputs/ under the current directory, which the worker sends at each step you report and when the run ends. The run's page on the hub shows them; the images of your tools' results may get there by themselves.

Repository: evo-agents. Branch: feat/fleet-demo.

# Goal of the plan
Members run plan steps on their own machines: the hub hands a ready step to the worker of the member who dispatched it, and the worker reports logs, state and evidence back.

# Context of the plan, shortened
The hub keeps plans as JSON bodies with one revision per write. Workers pull work over HTTPS and never open a port on the member's machine.

step-session:
You are running step 2 of the plan fleet-demo from the evo-agents hub, in an agent session of its own: this plan run gives each step not done yet a new session, with the handoff of the plan instead of the sessions before it.

Rules for this session:
- Do step 2 and nothing else. This plan run starts a new agent session for each step, in the order their depends_on allows, so the steps after this one get sessions of their own: do not run the plan, with the execute-plan skill or otherwise.
- .evo-run/plan.yaml holds the whole plan as this run was claimed, and `evo-agents worker plan` prints it as the hub holds it now. The handoff at the end of this prompt says what the sessions and runs before this one did; read the plan for what it left out.
- Record progress only with `evo-agents worker step`: `evo-agents worker step 2 in_progress --repo REPO` when you start the step, and `evo-agents worker step 2 done --repo REPO --evidence TEXT --verify COMMAND` (--verify once for each command) when it is done. When the step's acceptance names criteria of the plan's acceptance (a4), done also takes one `--proof ID=VALUE` for each: the test that proves it (path::test_name), the command that shows it, or `n/a: why`; done without one for each is refused. The worker runs each verify command again in that repo's worktree and refuses done when one exits other than 0; then it commits what is left there and pushes the repo's branch. Test what you changed, then run the whole verify once: `evo-agents worker step 2 verify --repo REPO --verify COMMAND` runs it on its own, past your turn, and done with the same commands reuses its result on an unchanged worktree. Both wait 540 s (--wait): give the call 10 minutes; on exit 124 run it again, never a loop of sleep. `evo-agents worker step 2 pending --evidence TEXT` hands the step back with what is done of it. Do not call the hub's plan_step tool, `evo harness step` or `evo-agents hub plan`.
- Ask the run's owner only a decision of one of these:
  - delete_data: deleting data that is not this run's own scratch: database rows, files, buckets, other people's branches
  - live_migration: a migration, backfill or bulk change on real data rather than a test database
  - external_send: sending anything to a service outside this machine and the repos' own remotes: mail, chat, issues, third-party APIs
  - spend_money: anything that costs money beyond this runtime's own usage: paid APIs, cloud resources, purchases
  - architecture: a design choice the plan leaves open that would change a contract it fixes (a schema, an API, a CLI surface, a seam) or cannot be undone; any other choice of design is yours
  - scope: a change to what the plan delivers that no route avoids (an acceptance criterion, an invariant or a non-goal), or a block only the owner can lift; a choice you can undo with a commit, that changes no real data and spends nothing beyond the runtime, is yours
  Decide everything else yourself, and write each such choice, why and how to undo it into the evidence of the step, on a line that starts with "Decision:".
- To ask: `evo-agents worker ask --category CATEGORY --question TEXT --context-file FILE --option KEY=LABEL[:DESCRIPTION] --recommended KEY --recommended-reason TEXT --step 2`, with 2 to 6 options. It prints the decision's id. Go on with the work of the step that does not depend on the answer; when none is left, end your turn. The answer comes back in this session as a message naming the decision's id, and the time you wait does not count toward the run's timeout.
- The person may answer on a phone, with one tap. Give every question that has a natural choice `--recommended KEY` and `--recommended-reason TEXT` (why that option, in a sentence or two); for an action, add `--reversible yes` with `--undo TEXT` (how to undo it) or `--reversible no`; and `--evidence REF` for each thing the question rests on, repeated: run:ID, output:ID, P-3/E-2, code:REPO:PATH or an https URL.
- When the work waits for a time, or for something that happens on the hub (a step of another plan done, a baseline of a canvas approved, a claim or a task changing, signals posted), wait for it rather than ask the owner to tell you when it came: `evo-agents worker wait --reason TEXT --until TIME --on KIND --contains KEY=VALUE --step 2`, then end your turn. TIME is 2026-10-30T09:00Z or a span such as +6h, at most 7 days ahead; KIND is plan.step, canvas.baseline, canvas.claim, tasks.status, signal.posted or srs.version.approved, and each --contains a key of the event's payload with its value: a step of another plan done is `--on plan.step --contains plan=PLAN --contains step=STEP --contains status=done`, which wakes as soon as it is done. Give --until, --on or both. The hub wakes this session with a message naming the wait when the first of them comes. An option of a decision that only means not yet goes with `--wait-option KEY` of `evo-agents worker ask`: choosing it leaves the decision open, and you hear nothing until a real answer.
- When a command lacks a credential, a variable such as an API key or a sign-in to the hub (`evo-agents hub` says not signed in), never ask the owner to sign in on this machine or to put it into `evo cred` here: ask for it with `evo-agents worker ask --category credential --question TEXT --env-var NAME --hub-account --step 2`, --env-var for the variable, --hub-account for the owner's account on the hub, or both in one decision. The hub gives the decision its options. Once the owner answered, read what it gave with `eval "$(evo-agents worker env --run "$EVO_RUN_ID")"` before the command that needs it.
- Never ask the owner to answer another open decision (one the hub asked, such as a stopped release cycle's, or one of another run): they have it already. Wait for what it brings instead, with `evo-agents worker wait --until +30m`, then look again.
  Add `--attach FILE` for a screenshot or a file the owner should see with the question.
- Commit in each repo's worktree, on the branch it is on. You may push, and merge into, the branch the plan names for a repo, even when it is the repo's default branch, and merge a pull request you opened into that repo's default branch with no question to the owner: merging is yours. Never push to a branch the plan does not name for that repo, never merge into any other branch, never force-push, and never rewrite history you pushed. After each push or merge into a repo's default branch that you make yourself (the pushes of `evo-agents worker step` send their own notice), run `evo-agents worker notify --kind push_default_branch --title TEXT --body TEXT`, or `--kind merge_default_branch`, naming the repo, the branch and the commits.
- To show the people who read this run a file you made (a screenshot, a video, a report), send it with `evo-agents worker output FILE --caption TEXT` (several files at once if you like), or leave it in .evo-run/outputs/ under the current directory, which the worker sends at each step you report and when the run ends. The run's page on the hub shows them; the images of your tools' results may get there by themselves.
- Keep .evo-run/ out of your commits. When you stop, because the step is done or because you cannot go on, write .evo-run/result.json as a JSON object whose "summary" says what you did of step 2, what you decided yourself, and what is left and why. The worker runs no verify command at the end of the session: `evo-agents worker step` ran the step's. When this session ends with the step not done, the plan run ends with it.
